command: direnv exec . bundle exec ruby script/explain_aggregation_options.rb
method: One EXPLAIN ANALYZE BUFFERS per public aggregation after exact bucket/metric and record-membership checks. No DDL, statistics refresh, or forced planner settings. Transactional Faker Tolkien rows roll back. Small fixtures and potentially warm caches do not establish production latency or throughput.

native_terms.sql: SELECT _tinkick_key, _tinkick_count, SUM(_tinkick_count) OVER () AS _tinkick_total FROM (SELECT _tinkick_value AS _tinkick_key, COUNT(*) AS _tinkick_count FROM (SELECT DISTINCT _tinkick_document_id, tinkick_elements.value AS _tinkick_value FROM (SELECT DISTINCT "tinkick_test_products"."id" AS _tinkick_document_id, "tinkick_test_products"."tags" AS _tinkick_value FROM "tinkick_test_products" WHERE (TRUE) AND (("tinkick_test_products"."name" ==> $1)) AND (TRUE)) tinkick_documents CROSS JOIN LATERAL unnest(tinkick_documents._tinkick_value) AS tinkick_elements(value)) tinkick_values WHERE (_tinkick_value IS NOT NULL) GROUP BY _tinkick_value) tinkick_counts WHERE _tinkick_count >= $2 ORDER BY _tinkick_count DESC, _tinkick_key ASC LIMIT $3
